subject: incorrect annotate-segment position with inverted limits

messages.author: 513f44c2c717c94a
messages.subject: incorrect annotate-segment position with inverted limits
parts:
Dear all,
I think I've found a bug in the annotate function of ggplot if limits are inverted.

This works properly:
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width)) +
  geom_point() +
  annotate('segment', x=5, y=2, xend=8, yend=4)

And this code misplaces the segment:
ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width)) +
  geom_point() +
  annotate('segment', x=5, y=2, xend=8, yend=4) +
  xlim(8,5)

I'm using:
R version 3.2.1 (2015-06-18)
Platform: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu (64-bit)
Running under: Ubuntu 14.04.2 LTS
ggplot2_1.0.1

Is this an appropriate place to report such bug?

Thanks a lot,
Iakov
